title: main.record
description: record parses assure record (ST-ASR-CMD01-CLI) and its flags.

title: main.gate
description: gate reads the subcommand: gateChangeCommand parses assure gate change (ST-ASR-CMD02-CLI) and gateReleaseCommand parses assure gate release (ST-ASR-CMD03-CLI), each with its flags.

title: main.ledger
description: ledger parses assure ledger (ST-ASR-QRY01-CLI) and its flags.

title: main.runDependencies
description: runDependencies parses stego deps (ST-BLD-CMD01-CLI) and its flags.

title: main.runBuild
description: runBuild parses stego build download (ST-BLD-CMD02-CLI), stego build (ST-BLD-CMD03-CLI), stego build verify (ST-BLD-QRY01-CLI) and stego build verify-source (ST-BLD-QRY02-CLI), each with its flags.

title: main.runImage
description: runImage parses stego image build (ST-BLD-CMD04-CLI), stego image publish (ST-BLD-CMD06-CLI) and stego image verify (ST-BLD-QRY03-CLI), each with its flags.

title: main.runImageSign
description: runImageSign parses stego image sign (ST-BLD-CMD05-CLI) and its flags. Not written yet.

title: main.main
description: main reads the first argument and calls the function that parses each command and its flags: runInit for stego init (ST-DECL-CMD01-CLI), runValidate for stego validate (ST-DECL-QRY01-CLI), runVersion for stego version (ST-DIS-QRY04-CLI), runFill for stego fill create (ST-EXT-CMD01-CLI), runTest for stego test (ST-EXT-CMD02-CLI), runApply for stego apply (ST-GEN-CMD01-CLI), runDrift for stego drift (ST-GEN-QRY01-CLI), runPlan for stego plan, which makes a plan (ST-GEN-CMD03-CLI) and gets the saved plan (ST-GEN-QRY02-CLI), and runRegistry for stego registry fills (ST-EXT-QRY01-CLI), stego registry inspect (ST-SUP-QRY01-CLI) and stego registry search (ST-SUP-QRY02-CLI). The commands of the other cmd/stego files are dispatched from main too.

title: main.runFleet
description: runFleet parses stego fleet (ST-DIS-QRY01-CLI), stego fleet measures (ST-DIS-QRY05-CLI) and stego fleet vex (ST-DIS-QRY06-CLI), each with its flags. Not written yet.

title: main.runLifecycle
description: runLifecycle parses stego lifecycle supersede (ST-DIS-CMD03-CLI) and stego lifecycle withdraw (ST-DIS-CMD04-CLI), each with its flags. Not written yet.

title: qualify-compiler-release.main
description: main parses the arguments of the release script: a revision and a result folder for qualify-compiler-release.py (ST-DIS-CMD05-CLI), and with --verify-release for qualify-compiler-release.py --verify-release (ST-DIS-CMD06-CLI).

title: install-compiler.main
description: main parses the arguments of the installation script, a revision and a result folder, for install-compiler.py (ST-DIS-CMD07-CLI).

title: main.runRecover
